description: This file defines the 'Screen' class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically within version 1 of the installer utility. The class encapsulates properties related to a user interface screen, such as name, module, URL, permissions, and optional menu configuration. It includes methods for constructing a Screen object from provided data, accessing its properties, and managing permissions via DataGroupPermission objects.

classes.name: Screen
classes.description: Represents a user interface screen in the installer module with associated metadata and permissions.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a Screen object from a name and data array, parsing permissions.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the screen.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL of the screen.

methods.name: getMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Returns the menu configurator string, if any.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the array of DataGroupPermission objects associated with the screen.
